shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region adjacent to a plotted line or curve. On the left, use the gray half-plane below the solid horizontal line. On the right, use the gray area above the x-axis between the two branches of the parabola.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It consists of points satisfying the lower-side inequality, including equality along the solid line. Right image: The shading selects the bounded region between the parabola and the x-axis from x = −5 to x = 5, whose top extends beyond the window.
Rationales: The left fill identifies where a plotted comparison is satisfied. The right fill selects a region from a function to its axis over a specified integration interval.
